validation.design: anchored expanding walk-forward; 30-day purge/embargo; feasible training candidates are measured OOS without a significance precondition; holdout opens only after rolling-OOS evidence
validation.multiple_testing: training feasibility uses completed trades, raw costed expectancy, profit factor, drawdown and regime breadth; ranking uses the deterministic 20th-percentile bootstrap mean R. sqrt(2 log K/n) remains descriptive and never gates OOS measurement
